```plato
//==
// # Regular grids
//
// Regular lattices over bounded regions: the axis-aligned cell decomposition
// that the discretized field and resampling descriptors of the other sections
// are defined against. Sampling
// metadata stays explicit so arrays of values retain their spatial meaning.

// A regular lattice of axis-aligned cells filling a planar bounding region.
// CellCounts gives the number of cells per axis; node counts are one greater
// per axis. Cell (0, 0) touches the minimum corner of Bounds
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_grid).
type RegularGrid2D
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
    CellCounts: IntegerVector2;
}
```
